en.headline: Tuen Mun water main leaks again near Tun Lai Street
en.dek: The Water Supplies Department is investigating a fresh leak on Castle Peak Road after yellow muddy water was seen gushing from the ground on Tuesday morning.
body: The Water Supplies Department said it had received a report of a fresh water supply pipe leak on Castle Peak Road near Tun Lai Street in Tuen Mun and had sent staff to the site to follow up.

Online videos showed yellow muddy water emerging from the ground near the same location that suffered repeated leaks earlier this month and in late July. Residents expressed concern that water supplies to nearby estates could again be interrupted.

The department previously confirmed that a 600-millimetre diameter steel fresh water main at the site had been included in its risk-based pipe improvement programme, with plans to start replacement works by the end of the year.

zh.headline: 屯門青山公路近屯利街再爆水管 水務署派人跟進
zh.dek: 水務署接獲報告指青山公路近屯利街有食水供水管滲漏，已派員到場處理，網上片段顯示黃泥水湧出路面。
body: 水務署表示，接獲報告指屯門青山公路近屯利街有食水供水管滲漏，已派員前往現場跟進。
網上片段可見近屯利街地面有黃泥水湧出，與本月初及7月底同一位置多次滲漏情況相近，有居民擔心附近屋苑食水供應可能再受影響。
署方早前已將該段直徑600毫米的食水鋼水管納入風險為本水管改善工程，並表示會盡快制定更換方案，以期今年底展開相關工程。
